name: ecocycle-ai-root
description: EcoCycle AI — Circular Economy E-Waste Diagnostic, Valuation, and Routing Engine

scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('server/dist/index.js')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && npm --prefix server start
scripts.space: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
